keyFindings.description: The Image comment said 18 is the major 'CI's Postgres service runs'. One CI service (.github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml:1094, owned by dispatch://INFRA-729) still runs 16.15. Fixed by the reviewer in its own prose commit: the comment now names the daemon's CI test job (pr-and-main.yaml's test job, whose service at :275 is pgvector 0.8.7-pg18).
The Outcome line said 18 is the major 'CI's Postgres services' run, the same overstatement. The reviewer edited the body to name the daemon's CI test job; a body edit changes no commit.

thermonuclear-code-quality proposed folding the four skip messages into one testpg.DSN helper. Not taken: the plan (decision D-b) chose the single testpg.Image constant and nothing further, the spec says change nothing else, and the four messages differ on purpose (each names its own go test package path). Not a defect.
